We announce the inaugural edition of the Provable AI Safety Seminars, a new monthly series dedicated to advancing research and development in provably safe AI systems.

The first event will take place on 2024-04-11T13:00:00-04:00 via Zoom.

Agenda:

  • "Synthesizing Gatekeepers for Safe Reinforcement Learning" by Justice Sefas
  • "Verifying Global Properties of Neural Networks" by Roman Soletskyi
  • Commentary and general discussion

RSVP at https://lu.ma/provableaisafety

The Provable AI Safety Seminars aim to bring together researchers and experts to discuss and advance the field of making artificial intelligence systems provably safe. The series will be held monthly on the second Thursday of each month.

To apply to speak at future seminars, please fill out the form at: https://airtable.com/appYgVucDqD7WkTyy/pagvLGoo9WCTI9ohk/form
For more information and to access the event archives, visit: https://www.horizonevents.info/provableaisafetyseminars

Regards,
Orpheus Lummis (Horizon Events) & Ben Goldhaber (FAR Labs)
